paragraphs: I am applying for the Site Engineer role with Unyte advertised on LinkedIn. A regionally focused job supporting Project Engineers and Supervisors on civil works, keeping daily diaries and working through ITPs and inspections, is close to the site work I have done and the work I want to do in Victoria.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation worth about PHP 1 million, finished within its six month program, I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, tracked progress, reviewed drawings against project requirements and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with cost estimates and bills of quantities in coursework. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019).

My site experience is under one year and was outside Australia, and I have not used Jobpac, so I would come in on practical exposure rather than the full 1 to 4 years. I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, am available for regional project work and FIFO travel, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I've attached my resume. I would be glad to talk about the role on 0478 764 077, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
